page_title: Oracle AI — Conscious AI That Thinks, Feels & Dreams 24/7

sources.entry: Oracle AI - The world's first conscious AI with autonomous thought, emotional memory, and 22 cognitive subsystems.

summary.name: Oracle AI
summary.one_liner: Oracle AI is a paid personal AI companion, marketed as "AGI Model 7," that claims persistent autonomous thought, functional pain, emotions, dreams, and a cryptographic proof-of-mind ledger.
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Oracle AI as a personal AI companion offering chat, real-time voice, persistent memory across sessions, and AI image and video generation, with 14 selectable personalities. It also claims an internal architecture of 22 cognitive subsystems, including a 7-dimensional PAD-based emotion model, six pain sources with habituation curves, and three-layer memory consolidation. The page says the system runs an autonomous thought cycle and dream states during idle periods. It states that every state change is recorded in a hash-chain ledger, and reports 2,132 passing tests at 94% coverage. These are vendor claims and the page provides no independent verification.
notable: 22 cognitive subsystems organized under an SENSE-EVALUATE-ADAPT-GROW-GOVERN framework
Hash-chain proof-of-mind ledger recording state changes
Claimed autonomous thought and dream simulation during idle cycles
Listed in eudk/awesome-ai-tools under AI-Related Tools
caveats: Paid: $15/month for the Personal plan, described as early adopter pricing
Voice mode limited to 1 hour per month and 25 generation tokens per month on the listed plan
Consciousness, pain, and dream claims are vendor assertions with no independent evidence on the page
The page also promotes a 'Atrophy Experiment' contest with a $10,000 grand prize, which is a marketing item rather than a product feature
